subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — OTEL and Prometheus exporter mappings

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this six-event AI-safety taxonomy and its public plugin SDK contract as a coordinated core feature?
rationale: The change creates a versioned public diagnostic vocabulary and a cross-plugin trust boundary; correctness repairs cannot decide whether that permanent product/API surface should exist.

options.title: Review the series as one contract
options.body: Pause landing until an owner approves the taxonomy, producer inventory, plugin authorization semantics, exporter mappings, and rollout order across all four PRs.

options.title: Sponsor the full taxonomy
options.body: Approve the core and SDK direction, then require the remaining producer, exporter, upgrade, and real-proof repairs before merge.

options.title: Narrow to existing diagnostics
options.body: Decline the new public taxonomy and instead extend current security and diagnostic events without adding parallel core or SDK contracts.

recommendation.title: Review the series as one contract
recommendation.body: Pause landing until an owner approves the taxonomy, producer inventory, plugin authorization semantics, exporter mappings, and rollout order across all four PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the affected OTEL export architecture and demonstrates the repository's expected real-export proof shape.
